plan.notes: Source: Vincennes University 2025-2026 Catalog (official, catalog.vinu.edu), 'Program: General Studies 2250, A.S. Transfer', 'Recommended Sequence of Courses', hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. A two-year program leading to the A.S. degree (60 hours). SCHEMA NOTE: the catalog sequences Semester I and Semester II fully but combines the second year into a single 'Semester III & IV' 30-hour block (Humanities Elective 3, Social Science Elective 3 (CC), Electives 9, Clustered 200-level Electives 15). To fit the term-by-term schema, that block is split into two 15-credit semesters in the catalog's listed order (III: humanities + social science + general electives; IV: clustered 200-level electives). The split is administrative only; every course, credit value, and total is verbatim from the catalog. The catalog's dangling '-or-' after COMM 143 (no alternative course named in the requirements or the sequence) is treated as a rendering artifact; COMM 143 is modeled as a single required course. Attribute marker (CC) preserved in choice notes. The program notes one course or combination must satisfy the WR/S Intensive requirement; the sequence does not name which, so it is not assigned to a slot. Prereqs live on individual course-description pages and are not modeled.
